decision.summary: A confirmed temporary multi-axis negative offset begins at index 665, persists through 685 with coherent behavior across N/E/U. A subsequent partial recovery (686–700) is observed in U and E but not fully resolved in N, leaving the return status uncertain. No full reversal to pre-offset levels is evident within allowed context [625,729].
